title: Garde Capital Inc. Buys 1,100 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Garde Capital Inc. increased its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.8% during the second the company in its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The firm owned 29,930 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after purchasing an additional 1,100 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up approximately 1.0% of Garde Capital Inc.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 21st biggest position. Garde Capital Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $5,540,000 as of its most recent filing with the SEC.
A number of other institutional investors also recently made changes to their positions in AAPL. Investment Partners LTD. raised its holdings in Apple by 4.9% during the second quarter. Investment Partners LTD. now owns 5,594 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,036,000 after acquiring an additional 263 shares during the period. Townsend & Associates Inc raised its holdings in Apple by 6.8% during the second quarter. Townsend & Associates Inc now owns 4,204 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $778,000 after acquiring an additional 268 shares during the period. Dorsey Wright & Associates raised its holdings in Apple by 9.2% during the second quarter. Dorsey Wright & Associates now owns 3,205 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $593,000 after acquiring an additional 270 shares during the period. Taylor Cottrill Erickson & Associates Inc. raised its holdings in Apple by 0.5% during the second quarter. Taylor Cottrill Erickson & Associates Inc. now owns 57,634 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $10,669,000 after acquiring an additional 270 shares during the period. Finally, First Bank & Trust grew its position in shares of Apple by 5.0% during the second quarter. First Bank & Trust now owns 5,772 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,069,000 after purchasing an additional 275 shares in the last quarter. 57.10% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors.
Get Apple alerts: AAPL opened at $165.48 on Friday. The stock has a market capitalization of $831.15 billion, a P/E ratio of 13.89, a P/E/G ratio of 1.22 and a beta of 1.20. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $150.24 and a 12 month high of $233.47. The company has a quick ratio of 1.09, a current ratio of 1.12 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 EPS for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The firm’s revenue was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the business posted $2.07 earnings per share. Analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 13.24 earnings per share for the current year.
The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, November 15th. Investors of record on Monday, November 12th were given a $0.73 dividend. The ex-dividend date was Thursday, November 8th. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.76%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is currently 24.52%.
A number of brokerages have recently weighed in on AAPL. DA Davidson restated an “average” rating and set a $280.00 price objective (down previously from $290.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday. Piper Jaffray Companies cut their price objective on Apple from $250.00 to $222.00 and set an “overweight” rating for the company in a research report on Thursday. UBS Group restated a “buy” rating and set a $210.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday. JPMorgan Chase & Co. set a $266.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Tuesday. Finally, Wolfe Research began coverage on Apple in a research report on Tuesday. They set a “market perform” rating for the company. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-five have assigned a hold rating and twenty-three have issued a buy rating to the stock. The stock currently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $222.77.
In other Apple news, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 14,194 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, October 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $227.96, for a total value of $3,235,664.24. Following the completion of the sale, the senior vice president now owns 105,538 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $24,058,442.48. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through the SEC website . Also, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last quarter, insiders sold 204,845 shares of company stock valued at $47,015,677. 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders.

Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
